story: Fort Verde State Historic Park is located in the town of Camp Verde, Arizona, and attempts to preserve parts of the Apache Wars-era fort as it appeared in the 1880s. Established in 1970, the park covers ten acres and features historic structures like the commanding officer quarters.
matters: The fort is significant as the best preserved and least altered of any military post associated with General Crook’s campaign against the northern Apaches.
name: Fort Verde State Historic Park
